import.title: CSV import
import.description: Preview and apply CSV rows for users, teams, or classification definitions (tenant-scoped).
import.hintUser: Required columns: email, name. Optional: role (viewer | tenant_operator). New users get a random password — reset via your auth flow.
import.hintTeam: Required: name, code. Optional: description. Codes are unique per workspace; re-import updates name/description (idempotent).
import.hintClassification: Required: key, label. Optional: color, sort_order, is_active (default true). Keys must match catalog rules; system keys update metadata only.
